description: PAdES long-term-validation ladder (pdfnative 1.7): B-B (sign_pdf profile=pades) -> B-T (timestamp=true, RFC 3161 token from the OPERATOR-configured TSA: PDFNATIVE_MCP_TSA_URL) -> B-LT (add_ltv: /DSS + /VRI through the operator revocation provider: PDFNATIVE_MCP_REVOCATION=ocsp,crl + PDFNATIVE_MCP_NETWORK_ALLOWED_HOSTS) -> B-LTA (timestamp_pdf: /DocTimeStamp). Without that configuration the network steps fail fast with TSA_NOT_CONFIGURED / REVOCATION_NOT_CONFIGURED and the server makes no network call. Finish with verify_pdf ltv=true to read back the achieved level. Each rung is an incremental revision; earlier signatures stay valid.
